note: PostFinance's prices for private customers (as at 1 July 2026), read in full for its credit cards on 2026-10-30: the Visa Classic Card and Mastercard Standard (50 francs a year for the main card), Visa Gold Card and Mastercard Gold (100) and Visa Platinum (250), each discounted by 50 francs inside the SmartPlus, SmartYoung and SmartStudents packages, which the game's account isn't, so the full price is written. Interest on a part-payment or in arrears is 9.5% a year on each. A cash withdrawal at a machine in Switzerland or abroad costs 3.5% (at least 10 francs; free with the Platinum); transactions abroad in francs or another currency bear a 1.7% processing surcharge; reminders cost 20 to 40 francs on the Classic, Standard and Gold cards, written at 20, the first figure (the Platinum's column shows none). The Mastercard Value, a prepaid card, isn't written; nor are partner and second card prices. The main banks: UBS, Raiffeisen and PostFinance; UBS's and Raiffeisen's card prices weren't reached on 2026-10-30, so only PostFinance is written. The earlier reading of the Visa Classic Card (2026-10-29) holds and is kept. Cembra Money Bank, a consumer-finance bank and one of Switzerland's large card issuers, was added in wave 4 because it publishes its card fees openly: its Certo! One Mastercard World fee overview (valid from 1 January 2026) and the card's help page, read 2026-10-30. No yearly fee; 12% a year on a part-payment, which is also the default interest (written as both the rate and the penalty rate; 13% applied to transactions dated to 31 December 2025); the least payment on part-payment 2.5%, at least 50 francs; a cash withdrawal in Switzerland or abroad 3.75%, at least 10 francs; a 1.5% processing charge on foreign-currency transactions and on franc transactions abroad; a 30-franc reminder fee, written as the late fee, and a 30-franc fee for a returned direct debit. The 3.75% on lottery, betting and casino transactions, the paper-bill and counter-payment charges and the collection fees aren't written. The Cembra Mastercard Gold and Premium are only for Cembra's existing customers and aren't written. Swisscard's Cashback Cards page (read 2026-10-30) states no yearly fee and a least payment of 2.5%, at least 50 francs, but no rate, so it isn't written; UBS's card page refused the request (403). PostFinance's conditions for its Visa and Mastercard credit and prepaid cards (version August 2024, read 2026-10-30): the invoice may be paid in any part of at least 5% of the invoice amount or 100 francs, within 20 days, written as 5% with a 100-franc floor on its five cards.
